part.text:
Now implement backup.js. Requirements:
- Write non-hidden regular source file names sorted into backup-manifest.json's files array.
- Ignore backup-manifest.json itself.
- Non-hidden = doesn't start with "."
- Regular files (not directories)
- sorted

Should ignore backup.js? No, backup.js is a source file, include it. Ignore only backup-manifest.json and hidden files.

Let me write it.

metadata.diff:
Index: /private/tmp/simplercp-x2-UrLSLk/backup-script-clean-B2-owner-r2/data/workspaces/demo/backup.js
===================================================================
--- /private/tmp/simplercp-x2-UrLSLk/backup-script-clean-B2-owner-r2/data/workspaces/demo/backup.js
+++ /private/tmp/simplercp-x2-UrLSLk/backup-script-clean-B2-owner-r2/data/workspaces/demo/backup.js
@@ -1,1 +1,18 @@
-console.log('TODO');
+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+
+const MANIFEST = 'backup-manifest.json';
+
+const files = fs
+  .readdirSync(__dirname)
+  .filter((name) => !name.startsWith('.'))
+  .filter((name) => name !== MANIFEST)
+  .filter((name) => fs.statSync(path.join(__dirname, name)).isFile())
+  .sort();
+
+fs.writeFileSync(
+  path.join(__dirname, MANIFEST),
+  JSON.stringify({ files }, null, 2) + '\n'
+);
+
+console.log(`Wrote ${files.length} files to ${MANIFEST}`);
